# OpenStreetMap Americana

The files in this directory are generated artifacts from
[OpenStreetMap Americana](https://github.com/osm-americana/openstreetmap-americana)
at commit `6098606aae8119de34a5de08e7bedc1ffdd712a8`.

They are the source of Map Room's Americana style. Map Room rewrites only
resource locations, removes the externally hosted terrain source, maps the
upstream font families to Map Room's locally packaged Open Sans glyphs, and
renames the building layer so the existing 2D/3D control can manage it.

OpenStreetMap Americana dedicates its source and artwork to the public domain
under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal waiver. The complete upstream
license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
